# Offscript Editorial

> Offscript Editorial is an asynchronous executive ghostwriting and thought leadership desk for B2B SaaS founders, CEOs and CROs. It turns podcasts, keynotes and voice notes the executive has already recorded into LinkedIn posts and essays in their own voice. No interviews, no recurring meetings, 48-hour delivery on fixed-scope engagements.

## Offers (USD)
- 48-Hour Cadence Calibration Test, $250, one per executive: 3 LinkedIn posts plus a 1-page Spoken Cadence Fingerprint, delivered within 48 hours.
- On-Demand Event Sprint, $950 per sprint, repeatable for each talk or launch: 5 LinkedIn posts (Monday to Friday queue) plus an Event Narrative Brief, from up to 60 minutes of audio.
- Executive Narrative Desk, $3,500 per month, month-to-month, capped at 6 partner desks: 12 LinkedIn posts and 1 flagship essay (800 to 1,200 words) per month, delivered on a weekly set day.
- Fees from the test or sprint are credited to month one of the Desk if the client joins within 14 days of delivery.

## Who it is for
Founders, CEOs and CROs of B2B SaaS, AI, cybersecurity, data and developer-tool companies, roughly $2M to $15M ARR, with recorded talks or willingness to send voice notes.

## What it does not do
Live interviews, graphic design, video editing, inbox or comment management, or posting to client accounts.

## Key facts
- Led by Kaung Sithu, Editorial Director (https://www.linkedin.com/in/sithukaung).
- Clients own the delivered writing on full payment.
- AI tools are used for transcription and analysis; a human editor shapes every post; client data is excluded from model training.
